name: zkUSD Dollar
oneLiner: zkUSD is an issuer-controlled ZKsync token minted through Goal3's verified portal; current reserve, redemption, and peg-maintenance evidence is unavailable.
collateral: Reserve assets, counterparties, and custody arrangements are not established by a current primary source; the deployed zkUSD token contract does not by itself prove collateralization.
pegMechanism: Verified portal code accepts owner-configured stable tokens, transfers deposits to a treasury, and mints a configured return token through a vesting flow. That code establishes an issuer-controlled deposit-and-mint path, but not 1:1 USDC redemption, current reserve coverage, or a peg-maintenance mechanism.

oracleRisk.summary: Goal3's verified portal implementation transfers approved stablecoins to a treasury and mints a configured return token through a vesting flow; it does not implement borrower collateral valuation or liquidation.

branchApplicability.rationale: The verified Goal3 portal implementation accepts owner-configured stable tokens, transfers deposits to a treasury, and mints and vests the configured return token. It contains no borrower debt positions, collateral-ratio checks, or collateral liquidation functions, so per-collateral oracle and liquidation branches do not apply to this issuance path.

routes.reviewNote: zkUSD is native on zkSync Era: the Goal3 protocol's UUPS proxy and owner EOA are covered by the reviewed mint-authority profile; no bridge carries the claim.

notices.title: Current reserve and redemption evidence unavailable
notices.message: The verified portal establishes an issuer-controlled deposit-and-mint path. It does not establish current collateral assets or coverage, 1:1 USDC redemption, custody arrangements, or a durable peg-maintenance route.

notices.title: Implementation date not established
notices.message: SONG Safety Score V9 implementation-date review on 2026-07-15 checked the Goal3 documentation and public site but found no reliable dated implementation or launch event; no date is inferred.

mintAuthority.summary: zkUSD is issued through Goal3's lockdrop portal on ZKsync Era. The token and minting portal are UUPS proxies owned by EOA 0x49a67aff9d3807351b8bb450f37ffc98af9def4d, with no permissionless mint route or upgrade delay.

controls.label: Goal3 owner EOA
controls.evidence: At zkSync Era block 71160345, owner() on both the zkUSD token and Goal3 portal returned 0x49a67aff9d3807351b8bb450f37ffc98af9def4d; eth_getCode on that address returned empty bytecode. The portal retained MINTER_ROLE on the token. Verified portal source calls returnToken.mint() in the lock path, and verified token source restricts mint() to MINTER_ROLE.

review.evidence: At zkSync Era block 71160345, zkUSD proxy implementation was 0xf0e28e2d31231e367d0dfe85da19a2dbc4ebb14b and Goal3 portal proxy implementation was 0xd3227d2b5c616dcf566ace0fec42507afef8e28d; both admin and beacon slots were zero. Both implementations returned the EIP-1822 implementation-slot UUID and verified source restricts _authorizeUpgrade() to onlyOwner. Both proxy owners were the same EOA, and the portal retained token MINTER_ROLE.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: zkUSD is presented as portal-issued and redeemable at one USDC, making it a reserve-style receipt rather than a borrower CDP.
